name: Direct flash
summary: A flash on the camera that fires straight at the subject, so that faces are bright, shadows are hard and the background goes dark.
how: Put the flash on the camera axis; do not bounce it.
Stand 1 to 3 m from the subject; let the background fall 2 to 4 stops darker.
Keep the red eye, the shine on skin and the hard shadow behind the subject.

origin.note: The Vacublitz flash bulb replaces flash powder and makes the flash safe to use by hand.

adoptions.via: Compact digital cameras fire their small built-in flash at each snapshot.
Party and nightlife photographers post direct-flash pictures from clubs to blogs.
